title: The path setting type accepts a Windows drive path and backslash dot-dot, so scratch_dir can leave the clone on Windows
goal: bl_base's path settings type (and so optpath) refuses a drive-letter path (C:/x), a path holding a backslash (so a .. written with backslashes too), a leading slash and a .. segment, while a plain relative path such as _cache/scratch is still accepted

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '_tools'); import bl_base; sys.exit(1 if bl_base._type_problem('path', 'C:/x') is None else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bl_base as b;p=b._type_problem;bad=["C:/x","c:x","..\\x","a\\..\\b","a\\b","/x","a/../b",""];good=["_cache/scratch","kb/_self/a.csv"];ok=all(p("path",v) is not None for v in bad) and all(p("path",v) is None for v in good) and p("optpath","C:/x") is not None and p("optpath","") is None;print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Premise run on origin/main at planning (2026-11-10): the repro or first check fails there on the behaviour named in the goal; not fixed by an earlier commit.
